```{r ggtheme, include=FALSE}
  theme_classic(base_size = bs) +

TC_LOWER <- c("a", "an", "and", "as", "at", "but", "by", "for", "from", "in",
              "into", "nor", "of", "on", "or", "per", "the", "to", "via",
              "vs", "with")

title_case <- function(x) {
  vapply(x, function(s) {
    w <- strsplit(s, " ", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    paste(vapply(seq_along(w), function(i) {
      tok <- w[i]
      if (grepl("[A-Z]", tok)) return(tok)
      if (i > 1 && tolower(gsub("[^[:alnum:]]", "", tok)) %in% TC_LOWER)
        return(tolower(tok))
      sub("([[:alpha:]])", "\\U\\1", tok, perl = TRUE)
    }, character(1)), collapse = " ")
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

fmt_p <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("italic(P)*\"=NA\"")
  num <- if (p < 0.001) "\"<0.001\""
         else paste0("\"=", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3), "\"")
  paste0("italic(P)*", num)
}

bracket <- function(x1, x2, y, label, size, lw, yr) {
  list(
    annotate("segment", x = x1, xend = x2, y = y, yend = y, linewidth = lw),
    annotate("text", x = (x1 + x2) / 2, y = y + 0.01 * yr,
             label = label, size = size, vjust = 0, parse = TRUE)
  )
}
```

```{r figure_helpers, include=FALSE}
panel_tag <- function(lab) {
  grid::textGrob(lab, x = grid::unit(5.5, "pt"),
                 y = grid::unit(1, "npc") - grid::unit(3, "pt"),
                 hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
                 gp = grid::gpar(fontface = "bold", fontsize = TAG_PT))
}

AS_GROB <- theme(plot.background = element_blank(),
                 legend.background = element_blank(),
                 legend.key = element_blank())

align_panels <- function(gs, tag_space = 0.22) {
  panel_left <- function(g) {
    l <- min(g$layout$l[grepl("^panel", g$layout$name)])
    if (l <= 1) 0 else
      grid::convertWidth(sum(g$widths[seq_len(l - 1)]), "in", valueOnly = TRUE)
  }
  pl <- vapply(gs, panel_left, numeric(1))
  gs <- lapply(seq_along(gs), function(i) {
    gtable::gtable_add_cols(gs[[i]], unit(max(pl) - pl[i] + tag_space, "in"),
                            pos = 0)
  })
  tw <- vapply(gs, function(g)
    grid::convertWidth(sum(g$widths), "in", valueOnly = TRUE), numeric(1))
  lapply(seq_along(gs), function(i) {
    d <- max(tw) - tw[i]
    if (d > 1e-6) gtable::gtable_add_cols(gs[[i]], unit(d, "in")) else gs[[i]]
  })
}

add_tags <- function(arr, labels = LETTERS) {
  pan <- arr$layout[grepl("^panel", arr$layout$name), , drop = FALSE]
  pan <- pan[order(pan$t, pan$l), ]
  for (i in seq_len(min(nrow(pan), length(labels)))) {
    first_in_row <- i == 1 || pan$t[i] != pan$t[i - 1]
    col <- if (first_in_row) 1 else pan$l[i - 1] + 1
    arr <- gtable::gtable_add_grob(arr, panel_tag(labels[i]),
                                   t = pan$t[i], l = col, clip = "off",
                                   name = paste0("tag_", labels[i]))
  }
  arr
}

safe_write_tsv <- function(x, file, ...) {
  ok <- try(write_tsv(x, file, ...), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(ok, "try-error"))
    warning("could not write ", file, " - is it open in a viewer?", call. = FALSE)
  invisible(ok)
}

save_grob <- function(g, out, w, h) {
  ok <- try(ggsave(out, g, width = w, height = h, device = cairo_pdf,
                   bg = "white"), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(ok, "try-error"))
    warning("could not write ", out, " - is it open in a viewer?", call. = FALSE)
}

save_panel <- function(p, out, panel_in = PANEL_IN) {
  gt <- egg::set_panel_size(p, width = unit(panel_in, "in"),
                            height = unit(panel_in, "in"))
  w <- grid::convertWidth(sum(gt$widths), "in", valueOnly = TRUE)
  h <- grid::convertHeight(sum(gt$heights), "in", valueOnly = TRUE)
  ok <- try(ggsave(out, p, width = w, height = h, device = cairo_pdf),
            silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(ok, "try-error"))
    warning("could not write ", out, " - is it open in a viewer?", call. = FALSE)
}
```

## 16S rRNA Gene Amplicon Processing

```{r microbiota_processing, include=FALSE}
parse_tax_summary <- function(fp) {
  read_tsv(fp, col_types = cols(.default = "c"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(taxlevel = as.integer(taxlevel), reads = as.integer(total)) %>%
    filter(taxlevel == 6L, !str_detect(taxon, "unclassified")) %>%
    dplyr::select(taxon, reads) %>%
    mutate(sample = sub("\\.tax\\.summary$", "", basename(fp)))
}

get_total_reads <- function(fp) {
  read_tsv(fp, col_types = cols(.default = "c"), show_col_types = FALSE,
           n_max = 2) %>%
    filter(as.integer(taxlevel) == 0L) %>%
    transmute(sample = sub("\\.tax\\.summary$", "", basename(fp)),
              total_reads = as.integer(total))
}

keep_samples <- map_dfr(mothur_files, get_total_reads) %>%
  filter(total_reads >= 1000) %>% pull(sample)
all_genera <- map_dfr(mothur_files, parse_tax_summary) %>%
  filter(sample %in% keep_samples)

genus_matrix <- all_genera %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = sample, names_from = taxon,
              values_from = reads, values_fill = 0L) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample") %>%
  as.matrix()

row_totals <- rowSums(genus_matrix)
row_totals[row_totals == 0] <- NA
genus_matrix[sweep(genus_matrix, 1, row_totals, FUN = "/") < 0.001] <- 0L

ra <- sweep(genus_matrix, 1, rowSums(genus_matrix), "/") * 100
ra[is.nan(ra)] <- 0

cf_pathogens <- intersect(c("Pseudomonas", "Staphylococcus", "Burkholderia",
                            "Stenotrophomonas", "Achromobacter", "Haemophilus"),
                          colnames(ra))
```

## Coinfection and Lung Function

```{r coinfection_groups, include=FALSE}
group_levels4 <- c("No pathogen", "Pseudomonas only", "Achromobacter only", "Both")
group_cols4 <- c("No pathogen" = "#d9d9d9", "Pseudomonas only" = "#e9f5a3",
                 "Achromobacter only" = "#911c43", "Both" = "#6c8197")
label_templates4 <- c("No pathogen"        = "No pathogen",
                      "Pseudomonas only"   = "<i>Pseudomonas</i> only",
                      "Achromobacter only" = "<i>Achromobacter</i> only",
                      "Both"               = "Both Pathogens")

build_groups <- function(thr) {
  tibble(
    Run       = rownames(ra),
    pseudo    = ra[, "Pseudomonas"]   >= thr,
    achro     = ra[, "Achromobacter"] >= thr,
    pseudo_ra = ra[, "Pseudomonas"],
    achro_ra  = ra[, "Achromobacter"],
    any_path  = as.logical(rowSums(ra[, cf_pathogens, drop = FALSE] >= thr) > 0)
  ) %>%
    inner_join(cf_metadata %>% dplyr::select(Run, FEV1), by = "Run") %>%
    mutate(FEV1 = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(FEV1))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(FEV1)) %>%
    mutate(grp = factor(case_when(
      !any_path        ~ "No pathogen",
       pseudo & !achro ~ "Pseudomonas only",
      !pseudo &  achro ~ "Achromobacter only",
       pseudo &  achro ~ "Both",
      TRUE             ~ NA_character_), levels = group_levels4)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(grp))
}

fev1_df <- build_groups(1)

n4 <- fev1_df %>% count(grp) %>% deframe()
axis_labels4 <- setNames(
  vapply(group_levels4, function(g)
    paste0(label_templates4[[g]], "<br/>(N=", n4[[g]], ")"), character(1)),
  group_levels4)

kw_fev1 <- kruskal.test(FEV1 ~ grp, data = fev1_df)
pw_fev1 <- pairwise.wilcox.test(fev1_df$FEV1, fev1_df$grp,
                                p.adjust.method = "BH", exact = FALSE)$p.value

```

### Dose Response Among the Coinfected

```{r coinfection_dose, include=FALSE}
coinf <- fev1_df %>% filter(grp == "Both") %>%
  mutate(cumulative    = pseudo_ra + achro_ra,
         Achromobacter = achro_ra, Pseudomonas = pseudo_ra,
         Other         = pmax(0, 100 - pseudo_ra - achro_ra))

sp_dose <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(coinf$FEV1, coinf$cumulative,
                                     method = "spearman"))
```

### Severe Disease

```{r coinfection_severity, include=FALSE}
SEVERE_CUT <- 30   # FEV1 pp threshold for severe disease

sev_ci <- fev1_df %>% group_by(grp) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), x = sum(FEV1 <= SEVERE_CUT), .groups = "drop") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(pct = 100 * x / n,
         lo  = 100 * binom.test(x, n)$conf.int[1],
         hi  = 100 * binom.test(x, n)$conf.int[2]) %>% ungroup()

sev_n <- setNames(sev_ci$n, as.character(sev_ci$grp))
sev_x <- setNames(sev_ci$x, as.character(sev_ci$grp))
fisher_vs_both <- function(g) fisher.test(matrix(c(
  sev_x[[g]], sev_n[[g]] - sev_x[[g]],
  sev_x[["Both"]], sev_n[["Both"]] - sev_x[["Both"]]), nrow = 2))$p.value
sev_padj <- p.adjust(c(fisher_vs_both("Achromobacter only"),
                       fisher_vs_both("Pseudomonas only"),
                       fisher_vs_both("No pathogen")), "BH")

chi_sev <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(table(fev1_df$grp,
                                             fev1_df$FEV1 <= SEVERE_CUT)))
```

### Specificity: Which Co-Pathogen

```{r coinfection_specificity, include=FALSE}
copathogens <- intersect(c("Staphylococcus", "Burkholderia", "Stenotrophomonas",
                           "Achromobacter", "Haemophilus"), colnames(ra))

adj_dat <- tibble(Run = rownames(ra)) %>%
  bind_cols(as_tibble(ra[, c("Pseudomonas", copathogens)] >= 1)) %>%
  inner_join(cf_metadata %>% dplyr::select(Run, FEV1, Age, BioProject),
             by = "Run") %>%
  mutate(FEV1 = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(FEV1)),
         Age  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Age))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(FEV1), Pseudomonas, !is.na(Age), !is.na(BioProject),
         BioProject != "") %>%
  mutate(BioProject = factor(BioProject))

n_present_adj <- vapply(copathogens, function(g) sum(adj_dat[[g]]), integer(1))

m_spec <- lm(as.formula(paste("FEV1 ~", paste(copathogens, collapse = " + "),
                              "+ Age + BioProject")), data = adj_dat)
co_spec <- summary(m_spec)$coefficients
ci_spec <- confint(m_spec)
cn <- paste0(copathogens, "TRUE"); keep <- cn %in% rownames(co_spec)

res_spec <- tibble(pathogen = copathogens[keep],
                   diff = co_spec[cn[keep], "Estimate"],
                   lo   = ci_spec[cn[keep], 1], hi = ci_spec[cn[keep], 2],
                   p    = co_spec[cn[keep], "Pr(>|t|)"]) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, "BH")) %>%
  arrange(diff) %>%
  mutate(pathogen = factor(pathogen, levels = pathogen),
         plab = vapply(p_adj, fmt_p, character(1)))

```

### Threshold Sensitivity

```{r coinfection_thresholds, include=FALSE}
thresholds <- c(0.1, 0.5, 1, 2, 5)
copath_all <- intersect(setdiff(cf_pathogens, "Pseudomonas"), colnames(ra))

res_thresh <- map_dfr(thresholds, function(t) {
  d <- tibble(Run = rownames(ra)) %>%
    bind_cols(as_tibble(ra[, c("Pseudomonas", copath_all)] >= t)) %>%
    inner_join(cf_metadata %>% dplyr::select(Run, FEV1, Age, BioProject),
               by = "Run") %>%
    mutate(FEV1 = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(FEV1)),
           Age  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Age))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(FEV1), Pseudomonas, !is.na(Age), !is.na(BioProject),
           BioProject != "") %>%
    mutate(BioProject = factor(BioProject))
  m  <- lm(as.formula(paste("FEV1 ~", paste(copath_all, collapse = " + "),
                            "+ Age + BioProject")), data = d)
  cm <- summary(m)$coefficients; ci <- confint(m)
  tibble(threshold = t,
         diff = cm["AchromobacterTRUE", "Estimate"],
         lo   = ci["AchromobacterTRUE", 1], hi = ci["AchromobacterTRUE", 2],
         p    = cm["AchromobacterTRUE", "Pr(>|t|)"],
         n_achro = sum(d$Achromobacter))
}) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, "BH"),
         thr   = factor(paste0(threshold, "%"), levels = rev(paste0(thresholds, "%"))),
         plab  = vapply(p_adj, fmt_p, character(1)))

```

## Comparative Genomics

```{r bgc_matrix, include=FALSE}
gcf_mat <- t(bigscape_pa)
gcf_mat <- (gcf_mat > 0) * 1L
storage.mode(gcf_mat) <- "integer"

gcf_md <- achromo_md[match(colnames(gcf_mat), achromo_md$key), ]
if (any(is.na(gcf_md$key)))
  stop("No metadata for strains: ",
       paste(colnames(gcf_mat)[is.na(gcf_md$key)], collapse = ", "))

gcf_row_order <- order(-rowSums(gcf_mat),
                       apply(gcf_mat, 1, paste, collapse = ""))

sp_tree <- ape::ladderize(ape::root(
  ape::read.tree("./derivedData/species_tree/astral.species.tre"),
  outgroup = "PAO1", resolve.root = TRUE))
tip_is <- sp_tree$edge[, 2] <= ape::Ntip(sp_tree)
strain_order <- rev(sp_tree$tip.label[sp_tree$edge[tip_is, 2]])
strain_order <- strain_order[strain_order != "PAO1"]
stopifnot(all(strain_order %in% colnames(gcf_mat)))
COL_ORD <- match(strain_order, colnames(gcf_mat))

clado_tr <- ape::compute.brlen(ape::multi2di(ape::drop.tip(sp_tree, "PAO1")),
                               method = "Grafen")
clado_seg <- local({
  nt <- ape::Ntip(clado_tr)
  x  <- rep(NA_real_, nt + clado_tr$Nnode)
  x[seq_len(nt)] <- match(clado_tr$tip.label, strain_order)
  for (nd in rev(seq(nt + 1, nt + clado_tr$Nnode)))
    x[nd] <- mean(x[clado_tr$edge[clado_tr$edge[, 1] == nd, 2]])
  d <- ape::node.depth.edgelength(clado_tr); h <- max(d) - d
  do.call(rbind, lapply(unique(clado_tr$edge[, 1]), function(nd) {
    k <- clado_tr$edge[clado_tr$edge[, 1] == nd, 2]
    rbind(data.frame(x = x[k], y = h[k], xend = x[k], yend = h[nd]),
          data.frame(x = min(x[k]), y = h[nd], xend = max(x[k]), yend = h[nd]))
  }))
})

```

### Alcaligin Pathway Gene Complement

```{r alcaligin_pathway, include=FALSE}
gene_levels <- c("ArgA", "ArgB", "ArgC", "ArgD1", "ArgD2", "ArgE", "Odc",
                 "AlcE", "AlcA", "AlcB", "AlcC", "AlcR", "AlcS", "FauA", "AlcD")

group_of <- c(ArgA = "Ornithine", ArgB = "Ornithine", ArgC = "Ornithine",
              ArgD1 = "Ornithine", ArgD2 = "Ornithine", ArgE = "Ornithine",
              Odc = "Putrescine",
              AlcE = "Alcaligin", AlcA = "Alcaligin", AlcB = "Alcaligin",
              AlcC = "Alcaligin", AlcR = "Regulation",
              AlcS = "Transport", FauA = "Transport", AlcD = "Reduction")

alcaligin_df <- alcaligin_hits %>%
  left_join(achromo_md %>% transmute(key, strain = Strain),
            by = c("genome" = "key")) %>%
  mutate(gene    = factor(gene, levels = gene_levels),
         present = as.logical(present),
         strain  = ifelse(is.na(strain), genome, strain),
         pathway = factor(group_of[as.character(gene)],
                          levels = c("Ornithine", "Putrescine", "Alcaligin",
                                     "Regulation", "Transport", "Reduction")))

key2disp <- alcaligin_df %>% distinct(genome, strain) %>% deframe()
alcaligin_df$strain <- factor(
  alcaligin_df$strain,
  levels = rev(key2disp[strain_order[strain_order %in% alcaligin_df$genome]]))

```

## RNA-seq: Differential Expression

```{r deseq2, include=FALSE}
ALPHA   <- FDR_CUT
LFC_CUT <- FC_CUT

rnaseq_out <- "./derivedData/rnaseq"
res_file <- file.path(rnaseq_out, "deseq2_results_coculture_vs_monoculture.tsv")

if (have_kallisto) {
  files <- file.path(rnaseq_work, "kallisto", rnaseq_samples$sample,
                     "abundance.h5")
  names(files) <- rnaseq_samples$sample
  missing <- files[!file.exists(files)]
  if (length(missing))
    stop("missing kallisto output:\n", paste(missing, collapse = "\n"))

  annot <- read_tsv(file.path(rnaseq_work, "ref", "PAO1_gene_annotation.tsv"),
                    col_types = cols(start = col_integer(), end = col_integer(),
                                     length = col_integer(),
                                     .default = col_character()))

  txi <- tximport(files, type = "kallisto", txOut = TRUE)

  col_data <- as.data.frame(rnaseq_samples)
  rownames(col_data) <- col_data$sample
  stopifnot(identical(rownames(col_data), colnames(txi$counts)))

  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi, colData = col_data, design = ~ condition)
  min_n <- min(table(rnaseq_samples$condition))
  keep  <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= min_n
  dds <- dds[keep, ]
  dds <- DESeq(dds)

  res_raw <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "coculture", "monoculture"),
                     alpha = ALPHA)
  summary(res_raw)
  res_shr <- lfcShrink(dds, coef = "condition_coculture_vs_monoculture",
                       type = "apeglm", res = res_raw)

  norm_counts <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)
  mono_cols <- rnaseq_samples$sample[rnaseq_samples$condition == "monoculture"]
  co_cols   <- rnaseq_samples$sample[rnaseq_samples$condition == "coculture"]

  mle <- rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(res_raw), "target_id") %>%
    dplyr::select(target_id, log2FoldChange_mle = log2FoldChange,
                  lfcSE_mle = lfcSE, stat)

  rna_res <- as.data.frame(res_shr) %>%
    rownames_to_column("target_id") %>%
    dplyr::rename(log2FoldChange_shrunk = log2FoldChange,
                  lfcSE_shrunk = lfcSE) %>%
    left_join(mle, by = "target_id") %>%
    left_join(annot, by = "target_id") %>%
    mutate(
      mean_monoculture = rowMeans(norm_counts[target_id, mono_cols, drop = FALSE]),
      mean_coculture   = rowMeans(norm_counts[target_id, co_cols,   drop = FALSE]),
      significant      = !is.na(padj) & padj < ALPHA,
      direction        = case_when(
        significant & log2FoldChange_shrunk >=  LFC_CUT ~ "up in coculture",
        significant & log2FoldChange_shrunk <= -LFC_CUT ~ "up in monoculture",
        TRUE                                            ~ "not enriched")) %>%
    dplyr::select(target_id, gene_name, product, feature, pgd_id, replicon,
                  start, end, strand, length, baseMean, mean_monoculture,
                  mean_coculture, log2FoldChange_shrunk, lfcSE_shrunk,
                  log2FoldChange_mle, lfcSE_mle, stat, pvalue, padj,
                  significant, direction) %>%
    arrange(padj, desc(abs(log2FoldChange_shrunk)))

  write_tsv(rna_res, res_file)

  vsd <- vst(dds, blind = TRUE)
  pca <- plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = "condition", returnData = TRUE)
  write_tsv(rownames_to_column(pca, "sample"),
            file.path(rnaseq_out, "pca_coordinates.tsv"))

  saveRDS(dds, file.path(rnaseq_work, "dds.rds"))
} else {
  rna_res <- read_tsv(res_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
}

rna_tested <- rna_res %>% filter(!is.na(padj))
```

## RNA-seq: Gene Sets

```{r gene_sets, include=FALSE}
CLASSIFIER  <- "PseudoCAP"
MIN_MEMBERS <- 3

# strip the leading non-breaking space some set names carry
tidy_name <- function(x) trimws(gsub("[[:space:]]+", " ", gsub(" ", " ", x)))

stopifnot(CLASSIFIER %in% unique(trimws(pao1_pathways$Pathway.Database)))

SET_DROP <- data.frame(
  set = c(rep("Pyoverdine synthesis", 4), "Pyochelin synthesis"),
  target_id = c("PA2254", "PA2255", "PA2256", "PA1165", "PA1165"))

SET_REDUNDANT <- c("Other", "isonitrile biosynthesis", "Sulfur metabolism",
                   "Cysteine metabolism", "Cyanoamino acid metabolism")

gene_sets <- pao1_pathways %>%
  filter(trimws(Pathway.Database) == CLASSIFIER) %>%
  transmute(target_id = trimws(Locus.Tag), set = tidy_name(Pathway.Name)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(set), set != "", target_id %in% rna_tested$target_id) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  anti_join(SET_DROP, by = c("set", "target_id")) %>%
  filter(!set %in% SET_REDUNDANT) %>%
  mutate(source = CLASSIFIER) %>%
  group_by(set) %>% filter(n() >= MIN_MEMBERS) %>% ungroup()

curated_sets <- tribble(
  ~set, ~members,
  "Outer-membrane TonB-dependent receptors", paste(
    "PA0151 PA0192 PA0470 PA0931 PA1271 PA1322 PA1365 PA1910 PA1922 PA2057",
    "PA2335 PA2398 PA2466 PA2688 PA2911 PA3268 PA3408 PA3901 PA4168 PA4221",
    "PA4514 PA4710 PA4897 PA5505"),
  "Inner-membrane iron and heme transport", paste(
    "PA4158 PA4160 PA4161 PA4222 PA4223 PA4358 PA4687 PA4688 PA4705 PA4706",
    "PA4707 PA4708 PA4709 PA5216"),
  "TonB-ExbBD energizers", "PA0197 PA0198 PA0199 PA0406 PA0693 PA5531",
  "Iron-sulfur cluster assembly", "PA3809 PA3810 PA3811 PA3812 PA3813 PA3814 PA3815",
  "Iron storage", "PA1008 PA3530 PA3531 PA4235 PA4880",
  "Acetoin and 2,3-butanediol catabolism",
    "PA4147 PA4148 PA4149 PA4150 PA4151 PA4152 PA4153",
  # PseudoCAP sulfur/cysteine metabolism minus the isc genes, tested separately
  "Sulfur amino acid metabolism",
    "PA5025 PA0399 PA0400 PA3816 PA2709 PA0932 PA0390 PA3107 PA2443 PA5379 PA1795",
  "Sulfur acquisition and assimilation", paste(
    "PA0280 PA0281 PA0282 PA0283 PA1493 PA1756 PA1838 PA2594 PA2599",
    "PA3935 PA3936 PA3937 PA3938 PA4442 PA4443"))

curated_sets <- curated_sets %>%
  mutate(target_id = str_split(members, "\\s+")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-members) %>%
  unnest(target_id) %>%
  filter(target_id %in% rna_tested$target_id) %>%
  mutate(source = "Curated") %>%
  group_by(set) %>% filter(n() >= MIN_MEMBERS) %>% ungroup()

gene_sets <- bind_rows(gene_sets, curated_sets)

rna_tested <- rna_tested %>%
  mutate(sig  = padj < ALPHA,
         up   = sig & log2FoldChange_shrunk > 0,
         down = sig & log2FoldChange_shrunk < 0)

n_up_all   <- sum(rna_tested$up)
n_down_all <- sum(rna_tested$down)

or_ha <- function(a, b, c, d) ((a + 0.5) * (d + 0.5)) / ((b + 0.5) * (c + 0.5))

set_names <- sort(unique(gene_sets$set))
geneset_stats <- bind_rows(lapply(set_names, function(s) {
  loci <- gene_sets$target_id[gene_sets$set == s]
  idx  <- rna_tested$target_id %in% loci
  x <- rna_tested$log2FoldChange_shrunk[idx]
  y <- rna_tested$log2FoldChange_shrunk[!idx]

  a_up <- sum(rna_tested$up[idx]);   b_up <- sum(idx) - a_up
  c_up <- n_up_all - a_up;           d_up <- sum(!idx) - c_up
  a_dn <- sum(rna_tested$down[idx]); b_dn <- sum(idx) - a_dn
  c_dn <- n_down_all - a_dn;         d_dn <- sum(!idx) - c_dn

  data.frame(
    set = s, source = gene_sets$source[match(s, gene_sets$set)],
    n_tested = sum(idx),
    n_sig_up = a_up, n_sig_down = a_dn,
    median_log2FC = round(median(x), 3), mean_log2FC = round(mean(x), 3),
    or_up = round(or_ha(a_up, b_up, c_up, d_up), 2),
    p_up = fisher.test(matrix(c(a_up, b_up, c_up, d_up), 2),
                       alternative = "greater")$p.value,
    or_down = round(or_ha(a_dn, b_dn, c_dn, d_dn), 2),
    p_down = fisher.test(matrix(c(a_dn, b_dn, c_dn, d_dn), 2),
                         alternative = "greater")$p.value,
    p_shift = suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(x, y))$p.value)
})) %>%
  mutate(padj_up    = p.adjust(p_up, "BH"),
         padj_down  = p.adjust(p_down, "BH"),
         padj_shift = p.adjust(p_shift, "BH"),
         across(c(p_up, p_down, p_shift, padj_up, padj_down, padj_shift),
                ~signif(.x, 3))) %>%
  arrange(desc(median_log2FC))

geneset_members <- gene_sets %>%
  left_join(dplyr::select(rna_tested, target_id, gene_name, product, baseMean,
                          mean_monoculture, mean_coculture,
                          log2FoldChange_shrunk, padj, direction),
            by = "target_id") %>%
  arrange(set, desc(log2FoldChange_shrunk))
```

### Iron and Virulence Categories

```{r rna_categories, include=FALSE}
SECMET_VF <- c("Phenazine biosynthesis", "Rhamnolipid biosynthesis",
               "Hydrogen cyanide production")
SECMET_PW <- c("Phenazine biosynthesis")
# H1-T6SS and flagella are not host-directed virulence; same cut in Fig 8
T6SS_VF   <- c("Hcp secretion island-1 encoded type VI secretion system (H-T6SS)",
               "Flagella")
IRON_VF   <- c("Pyoverdine", "Pyochelin", "Pyochelin receptor")
IRON_PW   <- c("Pyoverdine synthesis", "Pyochelin synthesis")
IRON_GENE <- paste0("^(pvd|fpv|pvc|pch|fpt|has[AR]|phu|hxu|feo|fec|fox|fiu|fem|",
                    "hit|pfe|tonB|exb|fur|bfr|ftn)")
IRON_DESC <- paste0("pyoverdin|pyochelin|ferripyoverdine|ferripyochelin|siderophore|",
                    "heme acquisition|heme/hemoglobin|heme-transport|heme uptake|",
                    "hemoglobin uptake|ferric|ferrous|iron uptake|iron transport|",
                    "iron-regulated|tonb-dependent|bacterioferritin|ferritin|",
                    "ferric uptake regul")

vf <- pao1_vf %>%
  filter(toupper(trimws(Source)) == "VFDB") %>%
  transmute(target_id = trimws(Locus.Tag),
            vfcat = trimws(Virulence.Category)) %>%
  filter(target_id != "") %>%
  group_by(target_id) %>% slice_head(n = 1) %>% ungroup()

pw_cls <- pao1_pathways %>%

rna_dat <- rna_tested %>%
  left_join(vf, by = "target_id") %>%
  mutate(
    gene_nm = ifelse(is.na(gene_name), "", gene_name),
    prod_nm = ifelse(is.na(product), "", product),
    iron_hit = grepl(IRON_GENE, gene_nm, ignore.case = TRUE) |
               grepl(IRON_DESC, prod_nm, ignore.case = TRUE),
    highlight = case_when(
      iron_hit | vfcat %in% IRON_VF | target_id %in% iron_pw_loci ~ "Iron",
      vfcat %in% SECMET_VF | target_id %in% secmet_pw_loci        ~ "Not highlighted",
      vfcat %in% T6SS_VF                                          ~ "Not highlighted",
      !is.na(vfcat)                                               ~ "Virulence",
      TRUE                                                        ~ "Not highlighted"),
    highlight = case_when(target_id == "PA0707"                 ~ "Virulence",
                          gene_nm %in% c("paaP", "plcB")        ~ "Virulence",
                          TRUE ~ highlight),
    highlight = factor(highlight, levels = c("Iron", "Virulence",
                                             "Not highlighted")),
    significant = padj < FDR_CUT & abs(log2FoldChange_shrunk) >= FC_CUT,
    neg_log10_q = -log10(padj),
    log10_expr  = log10(baseMean + 1))

```

```{r rna_category_stats, include=FALSE}
set_report <- function(idx, name) {
  x <- rna_dat$log2FoldChange_shrunk[idx]
  y <- rna_dat$log2FoldChange_shrunk[!idx]
  sig_up <- sum(rna_dat$padj[idx] < FDR_CUT & x > 0)
  sig_dn <- sum(rna_dat$padj[idx] < FDR_CUT & x < 0)
  up_out <- sum(rna_dat$padj[!idx] < FDR_CUT & y > 0)
  ft <- fisher.test(matrix(c(sig_up, sum(idx) - sig_up,
                             up_out, sum(!idx) - up_out), 2),
                    alternative = "greater")
  data.frame(set = name, n_tested = sum(idx), n_sig_up = sig_up,
             n_sig_down = sig_dn,
             n_past_both_cutoffs = sum(rna_dat$significant[idx]),
             pct_sig_up = round(100 * sig_up / sum(idx), 1),
             median_log2FC = round(median(x), 3),
             fisher_odds = round(unname(ft$estimate), 2),
             fisher_p = signif(ft$p.value, 3),
             ranksum_p = signif(suppressWarnings(
               wilcox.test(x, y, alternative = "greater"))$p.value, 3),
             signedrank_p = signif(suppressWarnings(
               wilcox.test(x, mu = 0, alternative = "greater"))$p.value, 3))
}

is_secmet <- (rna_dat$vfcat %in% SECMET_VF |
                rna_dat$target_id %in% secmet_pw_loci) &
  rna_dat$highlight == "Not highlighted"

rna_cat_stats <- bind_rows(
  set_report(rna_dat$highlight == "Iron", "Iron"),
  set_report(rna_dat$highlight == "Virulence", "Virulence"),
  set_report(ifelse(is.na(is_secmet), FALSE, is_secmet),
             "Secondary Metabolism (not plotted)"),
  set_report(rna_dat$target_id %in% vf$target_id[vf$vfcat == "Pyoverdine"],
             "  Pyoverdine (VFDB)"),
  set_report(rna_dat$target_id %in% vf$target_id[vf$vfcat == "Pyochelin"],
             "  Pyochelin (VFDB)"))
```

```{r pathway_ora, include=FALSE}
P_SHOW  <- 0.05
Q_SOLID <- 0.05

ora_up <- geneset_stats %>%
  filter(p_up < P_SHOW, n_sig_up > 0) %>%
  transmute(set, source, n_tested, direction = "Enriched in Coculture",
            n_sig = n_sig_up, odds_ratio = or_up, p = p_up, padj = padj_up)
ora_dn <- geneset_stats %>%
  filter(p_down < P_SHOW, n_sig_down > 0) %>%
  transmute(set, source, n_tested, direction = "Enriched in Monoculture",
            n_sig = n_sig_down, odds_ratio = or_down, p = p_down, padj = padj_down)

rna_ora <- bind_rows(ora_up, ora_dn) %>%
  group_by(set) %>% slice_min(p, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup() %>%
  filter(padj < Q_SOLID) %>%
  mutate(frac_enriched = n_sig / n_tested,
         direction = factor(direction, levels = c("Enriched in Coculture",
                                                  "Enriched in Monoculture")),
         signed_lor = ifelse(direction == "Enriched in Coculture",
                             log2(odds_ratio), -log2(odds_ratio)),
         neglog10q = -log10(padj),
         label = str_wrap(title_case(recode(set,
           "Pyoverdine synthesis" = "Pyoverdine biosynthesis",
           "Pyochelin synthesis"  = "Pyochelin biosynthesis",
           # formate dehydrogenase, catalase and SHMT; no methane metabolism here
           "Methane metabolism"   = "Formate and one-carbon metabolism",
           # liuA-D, the leucine/isovalerate operon
           "Acyclic isoprenoid catabolism" = "Isovalerate utilization")),
           30)) %>%
  arrange(signed_lor) %>%
  mutate(term = factor(label, levels = label))
```

## RNA-seq: Replicate Quality Control

```{r replicate_qc, include=FALSE}
if (have_dds) {
  dds_qc <- readRDS(file.path(rnaseq_work, "dds.rds"))
  qc_samples <- colnames(dds_qc)
  qc_cond <- setNames(as.character(colData(dds_qc)$condition), qc_samples)

  vsd_qc <- vst(dds_qc, blind = TRUE)
  V <- assay(vsd_qc)
  raw_counts <- counts(dds_qc)

  qc <- data.frame(sample = qc_samples, condition = qc_cond[qc_samples],
                   assigned_counts = colSums(raw_counts),
                   genes_detected = colSums(raw_counts > 0),
                   median_vst = apply(V, 2, median))

  C <- cor(V, method = "pearson"); diag(C) <- NA
  qc$median_cor <- apply(C, 2, median, na.rm = TRUE)
  cor_cut <- mean(qc$median_cor) - 3 * sd(qc$median_cor)

  rle_mat <- V - rowMedians(V)
  rle_long <- as.data.frame(rle_mat) %>%
    mutate(gene = rownames(rle_mat)) %>%
    pivot_longer(all_of(qc_samples), names_to = "sample", values_to = "rle") %>%
    mutate(condition = qc_cond[sample],
           sample = factor(sample, levels = qc_samples))
  qc$median_rle <- apply(rle_mat, 2, median)
  qc$iqr_rle    <- apply(rle_mat, 2, IQR)

  cooks <- log10(assays(dds_qc)[["cooks"]])
  cook_long <- as.data.frame(cooks) %>%
    mutate(gene = rownames(cooks)) %>%
    pivot_longer(all_of(qc_samples), names_to = "sample", values_to = "cook") %>%
    filter(is.finite(cook)) %>%
    mutate(condition = qc_cond[sample],
           sample = factor(sample, levels = qc_samples))
  qc$median_log10_cooks <- apply(cooks, 2, median, na.rm = TRUE)
  cook_cut <- mean(qc$median_log10_cooks) + 3 * sd(qc$median_log10_cooks)

  qc <- qc %>%
    mutate(flag_correlation = median_cor < cor_cut,
           flag_rle         = abs(median_rle) > 0.1,
           flag_cooks       = median_log10_cooks > cook_cut,
           outlier          = flag_correlation | flag_rle | flag_cooks)

  write_tsv(qc, file.path(rnaseq_out, "replicate_qc.tsv"))

  qc_cor_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor(V))) %>%
    dplyr::rename(s1 = Var1, s2 = Var2, r = Freq) %>%
    mutate(s1 = factor(s1, levels = qc_samples),
           s2 = factor(s2, levels = rev(qc_samples)))
  qc_pca <- plotPCA(vsd_qc, intgroup = "condition", returnData = TRUE)
  qc_pv  <- round(100 * attr(qc_pca, "percentVar"))
} else {
  qc <- read_tsv(file.path(rnaseq_out, "replicate_qc.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
  rle_long <- cook_long <- qc_cor_long <- NULL
  qc_pca <- read_tsv(file.path(rnaseq_out, "pca_coordinates.tsv"),
                     show_col_types = FALSE)
  qc_pv <- NULL
}
```

## RNA-seq: Fur Boxes

```{r fur_sites, include=FALSE}
UPSTREAM <- 300

SCAN <- "fimo_pa_"

LAB <- c(repressed  = "Enriched in\nMonoculture",
         background = "Not\nEnriched",
         induced    = "Enriched in\nCoculture")
COL <- c(induced = unname(HL_COLS["Iron"]), repressed = "#4b86b8",
         background = "gray70")

motif_dir <- file.path(rnaseq_work, "motifs")

if (have_motifs) {
  read_fimo <- function(set) {
    d <- read_tsv(file.path(motif_dir, paste0(SCAN, set, ".txt")), comment = "#",
                  show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE)
    names(d) <- make.names(names(d))
    d %>% filter(!is.na(score)) %>% mutate(set = set)
  }
  n_promoters <- function(set)
    sum(startsWith(readLines(file.path(motif_dir, paste0("promoters_", set, ".fa"))), ">"))

  fimo <- bind_rows(lapply(names(LAB), read_fimo))
  fur_totals <- vapply(names(LAB), n_promoters, numeric(1))

  # FIMO reports a site on both strands; keep the better and merge overlaps
  fur_sites <- fimo %>%
    mutate(center = (start + stop) / 2 - (UPSTREAM + 1),
           bin = round(center / 10)) %>%
    group_by(set, sequence_name, bin) %>%
    slice_max(score, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    separate(sequence_name, c("target_id", "gene"), sep = "\\|", remove = FALSE)
  write_tsv(fur_sites, file.path(rnaseq_out, "fur_box_sites.tsv"))
} else {
  fur_sites <- read_tsv(file.path(rnaseq_out, "fur_box_sites.tsv"),
                        show_col_types = FALSE)
  fur_totals <- read_tsv(file.path(rnaseq_out, "fur_box_proportions.tsv"),
                         show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::select(set, n) %>% deframe()
  fur_totals <- fur_totals[names(LAB)]
}

fur_hit <- fur_sites %>% group_by(set) %>%
  summarize(k = n_distinct(target_id), .groups = "drop")
```

### Replicate Jackknife

```{r fur_jackknife, include=FALSE}
jk_file <- file.path(rnaseq_out, "fur_box_jackknife.tsv")

if (have_dds && have_motifs) {
  leaders <- unlist(lapply(names(LAB), function(s) {
    h <- grep("^>", readLines(file.path(motif_dir, paste0("promoters_", s, ".fa"))),
              value = TRUE)
    sub("\\|.*$", "", sub("^>", "", h))
  }))
  has_box <- unique(unlist(lapply(names(LAB), function(s) {
    d <- read.delim(file.path(motif_dir, paste0(SCAN, s, ".txt")),
                    comment.char = "#")
    sub("\\|.*$", "", d$sequence_name[!is.na(d$score)])
  })))

  dds_jk <- readRDS(file.path(rnaseq_work, "dds.rds"))

  classify <- function(r) {
    r <- as.data.frame(r); r$target_id <- rownames(r)
    r <- r[r$target_id %in% leaders & !is.na(r$padj), ]
    grp <- ifelse(r$padj >= ALPHA, "background",
                  ifelse(r$log2FoldChange > 0, "induced", "repressed"))
    tapply(r$target_id, grp,
           function(ids) c(k = sum(ids %in% has_box), n = length(ids)))
  }
  tally <- function(r, label) {
    cl <- classify(r)
    bind_rows(lapply(names(cl), function(g)
      data.frame(run = label, set = g, k = cl[[g]]["k"], n = cl[[g]]["n"],
                 pct = 100 * cl[[g]]["k"] / cl[[g]]["n"])))
  }

  full_tally <- tally(lfcShrink(dds_jk, coef = "condition_coculture_vs_monoculture",
                                type = "apeglm", quiet = TRUE), "full")
  loo_runs <- lapply(colnames(dds_jk), function(s) {
    d <- dds_jk[, colnames(dds_jk) != s]
    d$condition <- droplevels(d$condition)
    d <- DESeq(d, quiet = TRUE)
    r <- lfcShrink(d, coef = "condition_coculture_vs_monoculture",
                   type = "apeglm", quiet = TRUE)
    tally(r, s)
  })

  jk <- bind_rows(c(list(full_tally), loo_runs)) %>%
    mutate(set = factor(set, levels = names(LAB)))
  write_tsv(jk, jk_file)

  jk_summary <- jk %>% filter(run != "full") %>% group_by(set) %>%
    summarize(n_runs = n(), mean_pct = mean(pct),
              min_pct = min(pct), max_pct = max(pct),
              # leave-one-out SE: the (n-1)/n factor, not a bootstrap SD
              jack_se = sqrt((n() - 1) / n() * sum((pct - mean(pct))^2)),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(full_tally %>% dplyr::select(set, pct_full = pct, k_full = k,
                                           n_full = n), by = "set") %>%
    mutate(lo = pmax(0, pct_full - 1.96 * jack_se),
           hi = pct_full + 1.96 * jack_se)
} else {
  jk <- read_tsv(jk_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(set = factor(set, levels = names(LAB)))
}

jk_loo <- jk %>% filter(run != "full")
```

### Motif Enrichment

```{r fur_proportions, include=FALSE}
wilson <- function(k, n, z = 1.96) {
  p <- k / n; d <- 1 + z^2 / n
  c((p + z^2 / (2 * n) - z * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z^2 / (4 * n^2))) / d,
    (p + z^2 / (2 * n) + z * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z^2 / (4 * n^2))) / d)
}

fur_prop <- tibble(set = names(LAB), n = as.numeric(fur_totals[names(LAB)]),
                   k = fur_hit$k[match(names(LAB), fur_hit$set)]) %>%
  mutate(k = ifelse(is.na(k), 0, k), pct = 100 * k / n,
         wilson_lo = 100 * mapply(function(a, b) wilson(a, b)[1], k, n),
         wilson_hi = 100 * mapply(function(a, b) wilson(a, b)[2], k, n))

jk_rng <- jk_loo %>% group_by(set) %>%
  summarize(lo = min(pct), hi = max(pct), n_runs = n(), .groups = "drop")
fur_prop <- fur_prop %>% left_join(jk_rng, by = "set")

fur_pairs <- combn(names(LAB), 2, simplify = FALSE)
fur_tests <- bind_rows(lapply(fur_pairs, function(pr) {
  a <- fur_prop[fur_prop$set == pr[1], ]; b <- fur_prop[fur_prop$set == pr[2], ]
  ft <- fisher.test(matrix(c(a$k, a$n - a$k, b$k, b$n - b$k), nrow = 2))
  data.frame(comparison = paste(pr, collapse = " vs "),
             pct_1 = round(100 * a$k / a$n, 2), pct_2 = round(100 * b$k / b$n, 2),
             odds_ratio = round(unname(ft$estimate), 3), p = ft$p.value)
})) %>% mutate(padj = p.adjust(p, "BH"))

cld_p <- setNames(fur_tests$padj, gsub(" vs ", "-", fur_tests$comparison))
fur_cld <- multcompLetters(cld_p, threshold = 0.05)$Letters
fur_prop$letter <- unname(fur_cld[fur_prop$set])

fur_bg  <- fur_prop[fur_prop$set == "background", ]
fur_ind <- fur_prop[fur_prop$set == "induced", ]
fur_one_sided <- fisher.test(
  matrix(c(fur_ind$k, fur_ind$n - fur_ind$k,
           fur_bg$k,  fur_bg$n  - fur_bg$k), nrow = 2), alternative = "greater")

write_tsv(fur_prop, file.path(rnaseq_out, "fur_box_proportions.tsv"))
fur_found <- fur_sites %>%
  left_join(dplyr::select(rna_res, target_id, product, log2FoldChange_shrunk,
                          padj), by = "target_id") %>%
  transmute(target_id, gene, product, set, position = round(center), strand,
            match_score = score, match_p = p.value, matched_sequence,
            log2FoldChange_shrunk, padj) %>%
  arrange(desc(match_score))
```

### The Published Fur Regulon

```{r fur_collectf, include=FALSE}
# PA#### tags are sequential, so a range expands by number
expand_tags <- function(s) {
  parts <- unlist(strsplit(s, "[/;]"))
  unlist(lapply(trimws(parts), function(p) {
    if (grepl("^PA[0-9.]+-PA[0-9.]+$", p)) {
      ab <- as.numeric(sub("^PA", "", unlist(strsplit(p, "-"))))
      sprintf("PA%04d", seq(floor(ab[1]), floor(ab[2])))
    } else if (grepl("^PA[0-9.]+$", p)) p else character(0)
  }))
}

ct_targets <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(fur_collectf)), function(i) {
  tags <- expand_tags(fur_collectf$target_locus_tags[i])
  if (!length(tags)) return(NULL)
  data.frame(tier = fur_collectf$tier[i], site = fur_collectf$sequence[i],
             operon = fur_collectf$target_locus_tags[i],
             gene_names = fur_collectf$target_gene_names[i],
             pmid = fur_collectf$pmid[i], target_id = tags)
})) %>% distinct(target_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

fur_targets <- ct_targets %>%
  left_join(dplyr::select(rna_res, target_id, gene_name, product, baseMean,
                          log2FoldChange_shrunk, padj), by = "target_id") %>%
  mutate(tested = !is.na(padj),
         call = case_when(!tested ~ "not tested",
                          padj >= ALPHA ~ "not significant",
                          log2FoldChange_shrunk > 0 ~ "enriched in coculture",
                          TRUE ~ "enriched in monoculture"))

if (have_motifs) {
  scanned <- unlist(lapply(names(LAB), function(s) {
    h <- grep("^>", readLines(file.path(motif_dir, paste0("promoters_", s, ".fa"))),
              value = TRUE)
    sub("\\|.*$", "", sub("^>", "", h))
  }))
  found <- unique(sub("\\|.*$", "", fur_sites$sequence_name))
  fur_targets <- fur_targets %>%
    mutate(is_operon_leader = target_id %in% scanned,
           scan_found_site  = target_id %in% found)
}
MAXDIST <- 500

if (have_kallisto || file.exists(file.path(rnaseq_work, "ref",
                                           "PAO1_gene_annotation.tsv"))) {
  ann <- read_tsv(file.path(rnaseq_work, "ref", "PAO1_gene_annotation.tsv"),
                  show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
  ann <- rna_res %>% dplyr::select(target_id, start, end, strand)
}

nearest_downstream <- function(mid) {
  if (is.na(mid)) return(data.frame(target_id = NA_character_,
                                    distance = NA_real_))
  d <- ifelse(ann$strand == "+", ann$start - mid, mid - ann$end)
  ok <- which(d > 0 & d <= MAXDIST)
  if (!length(ok)) return(data.frame(target_id = NA_character_,
                                     distance = NA_real_))
  i <- ok[which.min(d[ok])]
  data.frame(target_id = ann$target_id[i], distance = d[i])
}

ct_sites <- fur_collectf %>%
  mutate(mid = (start + end) / 2) %>%
  distinct(sequence, mid, target_locus_tags, target_gene_names, tier,
           .keep_all = TRUE)
assigned <- bind_rows(lapply(ct_sites$mid, nearest_downstream))
ct_sites <- bind_cols(dplyr::select(ct_sites, tier, sequence, strand, mid,
                                    operon = target_locus_tags,
                                    gene_names = target_gene_names), assigned)

fallback <- vapply(ct_sites$operon, function(s) {
  t <- expand_tags(s); if (length(t)) t[1] else NA_character_
}, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)

ct_sites <- ct_sites %>%
  mutate(placed_by = ifelse(!is.na(target_id), "nearest downstream gene",
                            ifelse(is.na(fallback), "unplaced",
                                   "CollecTF locus tag")),
         target_id = ifelse(is.na(target_id), fallback, target_id)) %>%
  left_join(dplyr::select(rna_res, target_id, gene_name, product,
                          log2FoldChange_shrunk, padj), by = "target_id") %>%
  mutate(promoter = ifelse(is.na(gene_name) | gene_name == "", target_id,
                           gene_name))

n_tested_ct <- sum(fur_targets$tested)
n_up_ct <- sum(fur_targets$call == "enriched in coculture")
bg_up <- sum(rna_res$padj < ALPHA & rna_res$log2FoldChange_shrunk > 0,
             na.rm = TRUE)
bg_n  <- sum(!is.na(rna_res$padj))
ct_fisher <- fisher.test(matrix(c(n_up_ct, n_tested_ct - n_up_ct,
                                  bg_up - n_up_ct,
                                  bg_n - n_tested_ct - (bg_up - n_up_ct)), 2),
                         alternative = "greater")
```

### The Pooled Fur Regulon

```{r fur_regulon, include=FALSE}
ct_placed <- ct_sites %>% filter(placed_by != "unplaced") %>%
  distinct(promoter, .keep_all = TRUE)

ev <- fur_collectf %>%
  group_by(sequence) %>%
  summarize(evidence = paste(unique(evidence), collapse = "; "),
            pmid = paste(unique(pmid), collapse = "; "), .groups = "drop")

val <- ct_placed %>%
  left_join(ev, by = "sequence") %>%
  transmute(target_id, promoter_gene = promoter, site = toupper(sequence),
            source = "Validated", evidence, pmid, tier,
            genome_position = ifelse(is.na(mid), NA_real_, round(mid)),
            site_strand = strand, distance, placed_by,
            fimo_score = NA_real_, fimo_p = NA_real_)
pred <- fur_found %>%
  group_by(target_id) %>% slice_min(match_p, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(target_id, promoter_gene = gene, site = toupper(matched_sequence),
            source = "Predicted", evidence = NA_character_, pmid = NA_character_,
            tier = NA_integer_, genome_position = NA_real_, site_strand = strand,
            distance = -position, placed_by = "promoter the site was found in",
            fimo_score = match_score, fimo_p = match_p)

first_ok <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) x[1] else x[!is.na(x)][1]
fur_fbs <- bind_rows(val, pred) %>%
  group_by(target_id) %>%
  summarize(across(c(promoter_gene, site, evidence, pmid, tier, genome_position,
                     site_strand, distance, placed_by, fimo_score, fimo_p),
                   first_ok),
            source = if (n() > 1) "Both" else first(source), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(dplyr::select(rna_res, target_id, product, log2FoldChange_shrunk,
                          padj), by = "target_id") %>%
  arrange(desc(log2FoldChange_shrunk))

stopifnot(all(nchar(fur_fbs$site) == 19))

# the reciprocal test: of the genes with a Fur box, how many went up
fbs_dat <- rna_tested %>%
  mutate(fbs  = target_id %in% fur_fbs$target_id,
         grp  = factor(ifelse(fbs, "Fur Box", "No Fur Box"),
                       levels = c("Fur Box", "No Fur Box")),
         up   = padj < ALPHA & log2FoldChange_shrunk > 0,
         down = padj < ALPHA & log2FoldChange_shrunk < 0)

fbs_tab <- fbs_dat %>% group_by(grp) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), n_up = sum(up), n_down = sum(down),
            pct_up = 100 * mean(up), median_lfc = median(log2FoldChange_shrunk),
            .groups = "drop")
fbs_fisher <- fisher.test(matrix(c(fbs_tab$n_up, fbs_tab$n - fbs_tab$n_up),
                                 nrow = 2), alternative = "greater")
fbs_shift <- wilcox.test(log2FoldChange_shrunk ~ grp, data = fbs_dat,
                         alternative = "greater")

# Fur represses the transcription unit, so operon members count as targets
MIN_GAP <- 100
ap <- rna_res %>% dplyr::select(target_id, start, end, strand) %>% arrange(start)
prev_end  <- c(0, cummax(ap$end)[-nrow(ap)])
nxt_i     <- findInterval(ap$end, ap$start) + 1L
nxt_start <- ifelse(nxt_i <= nrow(ap), ap$start[pmin(nxt_i, nrow(ap))], Inf)
ap$starts_unit <- ifelse(ap$strand == "+", ap$start - prev_end,
                         nxt_start - ap$end) >= MIN_GAP

assign_units <- function(idx) {           # idx given in transcription order
  cur <- NA_character_; out <- character(length(idx))
  for (k in seq_along(idx)) {
    if (ap$starts_unit[idx[k]]) cur <- ap$target_id[idx[k]]
    out[k] <- cur
  }
  out
}
ap$unit <- NA_character_
ip <- which(ap$strand == "+");      ap$unit[ip] <- assign_units(ip)
im <- rev(which(ap$strand == "-")); ap$unit[im] <- assign_units(im)

fbs_dat <- fbs_dat %>%
  mutate(in_unit = target_id %in% ap$target_id[ap$unit %in% fur_fbs$target_id])
unit_fisher <- fisher.test(with(fbs_dat, matrix(
  c(sum(up & in_unit), sum(up & !in_unit),
    sum(!up & in_unit), sum(!up & !in_unit)), nrow = 2)),
  alternative = "greater")
```

```{r supplemental_tables, include=FALSE}
sup_dir <- "./tables"
dir.create(sup_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
rnd <- function(x, n = 3) round(x, n)

fc_signed <- function(l2, n = 2)
  round(ifelse(l2 >= 0, 2^l2, -1 / 2^l2), n)

# ---- S1: amplicon sample metadata ----
s1 <- cf_metadata %>% dplyr::rename(Group = fig1_group)

# ---- S3: differential expression ----
s3 <- rna_res %>%
  transmute(`Locus Tag` = target_id, `Gene Name` = gene_name,
            `Product` = product, `Feature` = feature, `Replicon` = replicon,
            `Start` = start, `End` = end, `Strand` = strand,
            `Length (bp)` = length,
            `Base Mean` = rnd(baseMean, 1),
            `Mean Monoculture` = rnd(mean_monoculture, 1),
            `Mean Coculture` = rnd(mean_coculture, 1),
            `Fold Change (Coculture/Monoculture)` =
              fc_signed(log2FoldChange_shrunk),
            `log2 Fold Change` = rnd(log2FoldChange_shrunk),
            `log2 Fold Change SE` = rnd(lfcSE_shrunk),
            `log2 Fold Change (Unshrunk)` = rnd(log2FoldChange_mle),
            # left unrounded so a reader can sort on them
            `P-Value` = pvalue, `BH-Adjusted P-Value` = padj) %>%
  arrange(`BH-Adjusted P-Value`, desc(abs(`log2 Fold Change`)))

# ---- S4: Fur boxes ----
s4 <- fur_fbs %>%
  transmute(`Promoter Locus Tag` = target_id, `Promoter Gene` = promoter_gene,
            `Product` = product, `Fur Box Sequence` = site,
            `Source` = recode(source,
                              Validated = "Validated (CollecTF)",
                              Predicted = "Predicted (FIMO)",
                              Both = "Validated and predicted"),
            `Evidence` = evidence, `PMID` = pmid,
            `CollecTF Confidence Tier` = tier,
            `Genome Position` = genome_position, `Site Strand` = site_strand,
            `Distance to Start Codon (bp)` = distance,
            `Promoter Assignment` = placed_by,
            `FIMO Score` = rnd(fimo_score, 2), `FIMO P-Value` = fimo_p,
            `Gene Fold Change (Coculture/Monoculture)` =
              fc_signed(log2FoldChange_shrunk),
            `Gene log2 Fold Change` = rnd(log2FoldChange_shrunk),
            `Gene BH-Adjusted P-Value` = padj) %>%
  arrange(desc(`Gene log2 Fold Change`))

walk2(list(s1, s3, s4),
      c("Table_S1.tsv", "Table_S3.tsv", "Table_S4.tsv"),
      ~safe_write_tsv(.x, file.path(sup_dir, .y), na = ""))
```

```{r table_s5, include=FALSE}
iron_tbl <- rna_res %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj), padj < ALPHA,
         target_id %in% c(iron_cofactor$target_id, RECEPTOR, TRANSPORT,
                          ENERGIZER, EFFLUX, REGULATOR, IRON_HL) |
           grepl("^nuo", gene_name)) %>%
  left_join(iron_cofactor, by = "target_id") %>%
  mutate(
    class = case_when(
      !is.na(class)                             ~ class,
      grepl("^nuo", gene_name)                  ~ "Respiratory chain",
      grepl("^atp", gene_name)                  ~ "Respiratory chain",
      target_id %in% RECEPTOR                   ~ "Siderophore and heme receptors",
      target_id %in% TRANSPORT                  ~ "Inner-membrane and periplasmic transport",
      target_id %in% ENERGIZER                  ~ "TonB-ExbBD energizers",
      target_id %in% EFFLUX                     ~ "Siderophore efflux",
      target_id %in% REGULATOR                  ~ "Regulators",
      TRUE                                      ~ "Siderophore biosynthesis"),
    cofactor = case_when(
      !is.na(cofactor)                          ~ cofactor,
      grepl("^nuo", gene_name)                  ~ "[Fe-S] clusters",
      grepl("^atp", gene_name)                  ~ "None",
      class == "Siderophore and heme receptors" ~ "None, binds Fe(III)-siderophore or heme",
      class == "TonB-ExbBD energizers"          ~ "None",
      TRUE                                      ~ "None, iron-regulated"),
    basis = case_when(
      !is.na(basis)                             ~ basis,
      grepl("^nuo", gene_name)                  ~ "NADH dehydrogenase I subunit",
      grepl("^atp", gene_name)                  ~ "F1F0 ATP synthase subunit, no metal center",
      TRUE                                      ~ "Assigned from functional class")) %>%
  left_join(cofactor_ref, by = "basis") %>%
  left_join(class_ref, by = "class", suffix = c("", "_cls")) %>%
  mutate(doi = coalesce(doi, doi_cls),
         evidence = coalesce(evidence, evidence_cls),
         evidence = ifelse(is.na(evidence), "Assigned from functional class",
                           evidence)) %>%
  transmute(`Locus Tag` = target_id,
            `Gene` = ifelse(is.na(gene_name), "", gene_name),
            `Product` = product, `Functional Class` = class,
            `Iron Cofactor` = ifelse(str_starts(cofactor, "None"), NA_character_,
                                     cofactor),
            `Fold Change (Coculture/Monoculture)` =
              fc_signed(log2FoldChange_shrunk),
            `log2 Fold Change` = rnd(log2FoldChange_shrunk),
            `BH-Adjusted P-Value` = padj,
            `Reference (DOI)` = doi,
            `Evidence for Cofactor Assignment` = evidence) %>%
  arrange(`Functional Class`, desc(`log2 Fold Change`))

safe_write_tsv(iron_tbl, file.path(sup_dir, "Table_S5.tsv"), na = "")
```

### Figure 1A

```{r fig_1A, include=FALSE}
build_fev1_panel <- function(thr, show_title = TRUE, asp = 1) {
  d <- build_groups(thr)
  n4 <- table(d$grp)
  alab <- setNames(vapply(group_levels4, function(g)
    paste0(label_templates4[[g]], "<br/>(N=", n4[[g]], ")"), character(1)),
    group_levels4)

  pw <- suppressWarnings(pairwise.wilcox.test(d$FEV1, droplevels(d$grp),
          p.adjust.method = "BH", exact = FALSE)$p.value)
  getp <- function(a, b)
    if (!is.null(pw) && a %in% rownames(pw) && b %in% colnames(pw)) pw[a, b] else NA

  yr <- diff(range(d$FEV1)); ymax <- max(d$FEV1)
  l1 <- ymax + 0.06 * yr; l2 <- ymax + 0.15 * yr
  l3 <- ymax + 0.24 * yr; ytop <- ymax + 0.33 * yr
  brk <- list()
  for (cmp in list(list("Achromobacter only", 3, l1), list("Pseudomonas only", 2, l2),
                   list("No pathogen", 1, l3))) {
    p <- getp("Both", cmp[[1]])
    if (!is.na(p)) brk <- c(brk, bracket(cmp[[2]], 4, cmp[[3]], fmt_p(p), LABEL_MM, 0.4, yr))
  }

  ggplot(d, aes(grp, FEV1, fill = grp)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, notch = TRUE, alpha = 0.85, linewidth = 0.4,
                 outlier.shape = 16, outlier.size = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_cols4, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = alab, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 125, 25), limits = c(0, ytop),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = expression("Lung Function (FEV"[1]*" pp)"),
         title = if (show_title) paste0("Presence threshold = ", thr, "%") else NULL) +
    brk +
    base_theme() +
    theme(aspect.ratio = asp, legend.position = "none",
          plot.title = element_text(size = AXIS_TITLE_PT, hjust = 0.5),
          axis.text.x = element_markdown(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}

panel_1a <- build_fev1_panel(1, show_title = FALSE, asp = 1)
```

### Figure 3A

```{r fig_3A, include=FALSE}
open_dev <- function(out, w, h) {
  if (grepl("[.]png$", out)) png(out, width = w, height = h, units = "in",
                                 res = 300, bg = "white", type = "cairo")
  else cairo_pdf(out, width = w, height = h)
}

build_fig_3a <- function(out, sq_param = PANEL_IN, axis_pt = AXIS_TEXT_PT,
                         title_pt = AXIS_TITLE_PT,
                         leg_title_pt = LEGEND_TITLE_PT,
                         leg_text_pt = LEGEND_TEXT_PT,
                         fig_w = 4.8, fig_h = 8.1) {
  species_vec <- sub("^Achromobacter ", "A. ", gcf_md$Taxonomy)
  source_vec  <- gcf_md$Source
  pvd_vec     <- gcf_md$Induces_Pyoverdine
  col_labels  <- gcf_md$Strain        # display names keep the space

  species_cols <- SPECIES_COLS

  source_vec[source_vec %in% c("Environment", "Other")] <- "Other"
  source_relabel <- c("CF Sputum"          = "Sputum (CF)",
                      "Non-CF Sputum"      = "Sputum (Non-CF)",
                      "Unspecified Sputum" = "Sputum (Unspecified)",
                      "CF Oropharynx"      = "Oropharynx (CF)")
  idx <- source_vec %in% names(source_relabel)
  source_vec[idx] <- source_relabel[source_vec[idx]]

  # order here drives legend order
  source_cols <- c("Sputum (CF)"          = "#8cba7e",
                   "Sputum (Non-CF)"      = "#b3d3a3",
                   "Sputum (Unspecified)" = "#d2e5c4",
                   "Oropharynx (CF)"      = "#8cc1b6",
                   "Ear"                  = "#88a0c4",
                   "Wound"                = "#d4796d",
                   "Other"                = "#b3a6c4",
                   "Unknown"              = "#d9d9d9")
  source_vec  <- factor(source_vec, levels = names(source_cols))
  source_cols <- source_cols[names(source_cols) %in% unique(source_vec)]
  pvd_colors  <- c("Yes" = "#6b85a3", "No" = "#dde2ea")
  species_ordered <- sort(unique(species_vec))

  sq_in   <- sq_param                             # heatmap body is the house square
  anno_sz <- unit(sq_in / ncol(gcf_mat), "in")    # square annotation cells

  leg_common <- list(grid_height = unit(3.5, "mm"), grid_width = unit(3.5, "mm"),
                     title_gp = gpar(fontsize = leg_title_pt),
                     labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = leg_text_pt))

  bottom_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    `Ind. PVD` = pvd_vec, Source = source_vec, Species = species_vec,
    col = list(`Ind. PVD` = pvd_colors, Source = source_cols,
               Species = species_cols),
    simple_anno_size = anno_sz, annotation_name_side = "left",
    annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = axis_pt), gap = unit(0, "mm"),
    annotation_legend_param = list(
      Species = c(list(at = species_ordered, labels = species_ordered,
                       title = "Species", nrow = 3,
                       labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = leg_text_pt, fontface = "italic")),
                  leg_common["grid_height"], leg_common["grid_width"],
                  leg_common["title_gp"]),
      Source     = c(list(title = "Source", at = names(source_cols), ncol = 2),
                     leg_common),
      `Ind. PVD` = c(list(title = "Induces PVD", nrow = 1), leg_common)))

  # empty strip reserving room for the y-axis ticks and the alc label
  left_anno <- rowAnnotation(tk = anno_empty(border = FALSE, width = unit(10, "mm")))

  ht_3a <- Heatmap(
    gcf_mat, name = "GCF", rect_gp = gpar(type = "none"),
    cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
      fillcol <- if (gcf_mat[i, j] < 1) "white"
                 else if (rownames(gcf_mat)[i] == ALC_FAM) "#f7ce46"
                 else if (rownames(gcf_mat)[i] == MET_FAM &&
                          colnames(gcf_mat)[j] == MET_STRAIN) "#b7410e"
                 else "black"
      grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = fillcol, col = NA))
    },
    cluster_rows = FALSE, row_order = gcf_row_order,
    cluster_columns = FALSE, column_order = COL_ORD,
    top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(
      clado = anno_empty(height = unit(1.6, "cm"), border = FALSE),
      show_annotation_name = FALSE),
    show_row_names = FALSE, column_labels = col_labels,
    column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = axis_pt), column_names_rot = 45,
    column_names_side = "bottom",
    row_title = "BGC", row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = title_pt, fontface = "bold"),
    column_title = NULL, bottom_annotation = bottom_anno,
    left_annotation = left_anno, show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
    width = unit(sq_in, "in"), height = unit(sq_in, "in"),
    border = TRUE, border_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 0.5))

  # cairo_pdf draws a real ASCII hyphen; base pdf() draws a long minus
    open_dev(out, fig_w, fig_h)
  ht_drawn <- draw(ht_3a, annotation_legend_side = "bottom",
                   heatmap_legend_side = "bottom", merge_legends = TRUE)
  ro <- row_order(ht_drawn); n <- length(ro)
  decorate_heatmap_body("GCF", {
    pushViewport(viewport(clip = "off"))
    for (p in seq_len(n)) {
      yk <- unit(1 - (p - 0.5) / n, "npc")
      grid.segments(unit(0, "npc"), yk, unit(0, "npc") - unit(1, "mm"), yk,
                    gp = gpar(lwd = 0.6))
      if (rownames(gcf_mat)[ro[p]] == ALC_FAM)
        grid.text("alc", x = unit(0, "npc") - unit(1.6, "mm"), y = yk,
                  just = "right", gp = gpar(fontface = "italic", fontsize = axis_pt))
    }
    popViewport()
  })

  decorate_annotation("clado", {
    pushViewport(viewport(clip = "off"))
    ns <- ncol(gcf_mat); ym <- max(clado_seg$y, clado_seg$yend)
    grid.segments((clado_seg$x - 0.5) / ns, clado_seg$y / ym,
                  (clado_seg$xend - 0.5) / ns, clado_seg$yend / ym,
                  gp = gpar(lwd = 1.2))
    popViewport()
  })
  invisible(dev.off())
}

build_fig_3a("./figures/Figure_3A.pdf")
```

```{r fig_7BC, include=FALSE}
  annotation_custom(ggplotGrob(inset),
                    xmin = fx(0.005), xmax = fx(0.475),
                    ymin = fy(0.67),   ymax = fy(1.03)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = FBS_COL, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-FBS_XLIM, FBS_XLIM),
                     breaks = seq(-FBS_XLIM, FBS_XLIM, 1),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(NA, FBS_YTOP),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.02))) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(order = 1, nrow = 1,
                             override.aes = list(size = 2.6)),
         size = guide_legend(order = 2, nrow = 1)) +
  labs(x = XLAB_LFC, y = YLAB_Q) +
  base_theme() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))

panel_fur_resp <- build_fbs_volcano()
```

### Figure 7

```{r fig_7, include=FALSE}
pin <- function(p, h = PANEL_IN)
  egg::set_panel_size(p + AS_GROB, width = unit(PANEL_IN, "in"),
                      height = unit(h, "in"))
win <- function(g) grid::convertWidth(sum(g$widths), "in", valueOnly = TRUE)
hin <- function(g) grid::convertHeight(sum(g$heights), "in", valueOnly = TRUE)
pad_bottom <- function(g, H) {
  d <- H - hin(g)
  if (d > 1e-6) gtable::gtable_add_rows(g, unit(d, "in")) else g
}

gs_mid <- align_panels(list(pin(panel_fur_logo, h = 0.9), pin(panel_fur_resp)))
gs_mid <- Map(add_tags, gs_mid, c("B", "C"))

g_a <- add_tags(pin(panel_7a), "A")   
g_d <- add_tags(pin(panel_7b), "D")

h_hat  <- hin(gs_mid[[1]])
h_body <- max(hin(g_a), hin(g_d), hin(gs_mid[[2]]))
g_a <- pad_bottom(g_a, h_body)
g_d <- pad_bottom(g_d, h_body)
gs_mid[[2]] <- pad_bottom(gs_mid[[2]], h_body)

mid <- gridExtra::arrangeGrob(grobs = gs_mid, ncol = 1,
                              heights = unit(c(h_hat, h_body), "in"))

ws <- c(win(g_a), win(gs_mid[[1]]), win(g_d))
arr_7 <- gridExtra::arrangeGrob(
  grobs = list(g_a, mid, g_d),
  layout_matrix = rbind(c(NA, 2, NA),
                        c(1,  2, 3)),
  widths = unit(ws, "in"), heights = unit(c(h_hat, h_body), "in"))

save_grob(arr_7, "./figures/Figure_7.pdf", sum(ws), h_hat + h_body)
```

### Figure 8

```{r fig_8, include=FALSE}
prot_volcano_panel <- function(d, label_all = FALSE) {
  hl <- filter(d, highlight != "Not highlighted", significant) %>%
    droplevels() %>%
    arrange(highlight == "Virulence")
  bg <- anti_join(d, hl, by = "Accession")
  lab <- (if (label_all) filter(d, significant) else filter(d, do_label)) %>%

    mutate(nx = case_when(label == "toxA" ~ 0.20, label == "lasB" ~ 0.02,
                          label == "plcB" ~ 0.30, label == "Pyocin S4" ~ 0.22,
                          label == "cdrA" ~ 0.15, label == "pra" ~ 0.02,
                          label == "liuR" ~ -0.05, TRUE ~ 0),
           ny = case_when(label == "toxA" ~ 0.05, label == "lasB" ~ 0.14,
                          label == "plcB" ~ -0.12, label == "Pyocin S4" ~ 0.15,
                          label == "cdrA" ~ 0.03, label == "pra" ~ 0.14,
                          label == "liuR" ~ 0.12, TRUE ~ 0))
  ggplot() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(FDR_CUT), linetype = "dashed",
               color = GUIDE_COL, linewidth = GUIDE_LW) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-FC_CUT, FC_CUT), linetype = "dashed",
               color = GUIDE_COL, linewidth = GUIDE_LW) +
    geom_point(data = bg, aes(log2FC, neg_log10_adj_p, size = log10_intensity),
               color = "gray74", fill = "gray86", shape = 21, stroke = 0.12,
               alpha = 0.55) +
    geom_point(data = hl, aes(log2FC, neg_log10_adj_p, size = log10_intensity,
                              fill = highlight),
               color = "black", shape = 21, stroke = 0.3) +
    geom_text_repel(data = lab, aes(log2FC, neg_log10_adj_p, label = label_disp,
                                    color = highlight),
                    nudge_x = lab$nx, nudge_y = lab$ny, fontface = "plain",
                    size = LABEL_MM, segment.size = 0.2,
                    segment.color = "gray55",
                    min.segment.length = 0, box.padding = 0.28,
                    max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = HL_COLS, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(HL_COLS, "Not highlighted" = "gray25"),
                        guide = "none") +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.12, 2.6), breaks = c(7, 8, 9, 10, 11),
                          name = expression(log[10]~"Intensity")) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2), order = 1),
           size = guide_legend(order = 2)) +
    labs(x = XLAB_LFC, y = YLAB_Q) +
    base_theme()
}

FLAGELLAR <- c("flgD", "flgE", "flgH", "flgI", "flgK", "flgL", "flhA", "fliA",
               "fliC", "fliD", "fliF", "fliG", "fliI", "fliM", "fliN", "fliO",
               "motA", "motB", "motD")

fig8_dat <- prot_dat %>%
  filter(secreted) %>%
  mutate(highlight = ifelse(Gene %in% FLAGELLAR, "Not highlighted",
                            as.character(highlight)),
         highlight = factor(highlight, levels = levels(prot_dat$highlight)),
         significant = adj_p < FDR_CUT,
         do_label = significant &
           (highlight != "Not highlighted" | label == "Pyocin S4"))

save_panel(prot_volcano_panel(fig8_dat),
           "./figures/Figure_8.pdf")
```

```{r fig_S1B, include=FALSE}
lab_rho <- paste0("italic(rho)*\"=",
                  formatC(unname(sp_dose$estimate), format = "f", digits = 2), "\"")
lab_p   <- paste0("italic(P)*\"=",
                  formatC(sp_dose$p.value, format = "f", digits = 3), "\"")

set.seed(SEED)
coinf_j <- coinf %>% mutate(xj = pmin(100, cumulative + runif(n(), -2, 2)),
                            yj = FEV1 + runif(n(), -2, 2))
pie_pal <- c(Achromobacter = "#911c43", Pseudomonas = "#e9f5a3",
             Other = "#d9d9d9")

leg_df <- tibble(x = 50, y = 60,
                 cat = factor(c("Achromobacter", "Pseudomonas", "Other"),
                              levels = c("Achromobacter", "Pseudomonas", "Other")))

panel_s1b <- ggplot() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 50, linetype = 2, color = "gray50") +
  geom_smooth(data = coinf_j, aes(cumulative, FEV1), method = "lm",
              formula = y ~ x, se = TRUE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5,
              fill = "gray80") +
  geom_scatterpie(data = coinf_j, aes(x = xj, y = yj, r = 1.5),
                  cols = c("Achromobacter", "Pseudomonas", "Other"),
                  color = "black", linewidth = 0.1, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(data = leg_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = cat), shape = 21,
             alpha = 0, size = 3.4, stroke = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pie_pal, name = NULL,
                    breaks = c("Achromobacter", "Pseudomonas", "Other"),
                    labels = c("<i>Achromobacter</i>", "<i>Pseudomonas</i>", "Other"),
                    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3.4,
                                                             stroke = 0.3))) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 25), limits = c(-3, 103),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 125, 25), limits = c(0, 125),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.03))) +
  annotate("text", x = 66, y = 124, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, label = lab_rho,
           parse = TRUE, size = LABEL_MM) +
  annotate("text", x = 66, y = 117, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, label = lab_p,
           parse = TRUE, size = LABEL_MM) +
  labs(x = "Combined Relative Abundance of<br><i>Achromobacter</i> and <i>Pseudomonas</i> (%)",
       y = expression("Lung Function (FEV"[1]*" pp)")) +
  base_theme() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1, axis.title.x = element_markdown(color = "black"),
        legend.position = "bottom", legend.text = element_markdown(),
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
```

```{r core_species_tree, include=FALSE}
sp_lab <- setNames(sub("^Achromobacter ", "A. ", achromo_md$Taxonomy), achromo_md$key)
sp_lab["PAO1"] <- "P. aeruginosa (outgroup)"
tree_species <- sp_lab[sp_tree$tip.label]

tree_fig <- sp_tree
tree_fig$tip.label <- paste0(sub("DSM", "DSM ", sp_tree$tip.label), "   ", tree_species)
sup <- tree_fig$node.label
sup[is.na(sup) | sup %in% c("", "Root", "NA")] <- ""

cairo_pdf("./derivedData/species_tree/species_tree.pdf", width = 8.5, height = 6)

     tip.color = "black", font = 1, edge.width = 1.6, x.lim = c(0, 42))
ape::nodelabels(sup, frame = "none", cex = 0.58, adj = c(1.15, -0.35),
```
